project.title: Getting Started with Digital Accessibility
project.description: Digital accessibility affects more than websites. From emails and presentations to documents and online training, the digital content we create and share can either support or limit someone's ability to access information. This introductory course explores digital accessibility through the four POUR principles: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust. Using relatable workplace examples, learners will discover how accessibility practices support people with different abilities, needs, and circumstances and recognize common misconceptions about creating accessible digital content.
